paragraph_requires: the Company applies the two-class method of computing earnings per share
All references made to share or per share amounts in the accompanying consolidated financial statements and applicable disclosures have been retroactively adjusted
No LTIP Unit share equivalents were included in the computation for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023
decisions.reader_note: For American Strategic Investment in 2023–2025, the filing applies two-class accounting to participating restricted shares, Class A Units and unearned LTIP Units. Its EPS table reports zero numerator adjustments for all three years. Potential common equivalents are excluded as anti-dilutive; the LTIP discussion also states that no units would have been earned under the stated measurement conditions and/or that loss-period dilution would be anti-dilutive. The January 2023 one-for-eight reverse split is already reflected retrospectively. Full scale-zero shares and EPS are retained without a second split adjustment.

paragraph_requires: including potential dilutive common shares using the treasury stock method
outstanding stock options and restricted stock units have been excluded
decisions.reader_note: For 1stdibs.com in 2023–2025, outstanding options and restricted stock units are excluded from diluted loss per share because their effect is anti-dilutive in each presented period. The filing describes the treasury-stock method for potential dilution; basic shares exclude that potential dilution. Full scale-zero share counts and EPS remain unchanged under the statement’s share/per-share exception to its thousands heading.
